scope: Private pre-authentication challenge persistence and fixed server boundary; not an authenticator, identity issuer or production adapter.
claims: No direct API table writes, tenant identity or session/grant issuance.
Challenge state and browser proof are independent 256-bit random values; only digests reach SQL.
Owner-configured binding snapshot and current exact tuple are both required at atomic consumption.
No WorkOS key, callback endpoint, provider exchange, PKCE implementation or hosted deployment.
remaining: Qualified secret broker and audited mapping/issuer
Actual provider and regional infrastructure qualification
review_findings: Reject wildcard callback syntax explicitly; the standard URL parser accepts wildcard hosts.
Freeze each challenge configuration snapshot and compare it against current locked owner configuration; changed environments/callbacks cannot relabel an existing proof.
Recheck expiry using database clock_timestamp after row-lock acquisition; statement start time alone permits an expired proof after waiting. Actual row-lock expiry test verifies the fix.
